AlertDialogRoot.description: Holds the alert dialog's open state. It is a DialogRoot that is always modal, has `role="alertdialog"` and ignores a press outside.

props.open: Whether the alert dialog is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control it.
props.defaultOpen: Whether the alert dialog is open at first, when it isn't controlled.
props.onOpenChange: Called when a part or Escape asks to open or close the alert dialog. A controlled alert dialog changes only when `open` does.

AlertDialogTrigger.description: The button that opens the alert dialog. Optional when the dialog is controlled.

dataAttributes.data-popup-open: Present while the alert dialog is open.

AlertDialogPopup.description: The `<dialog>` element, with `role="alertdialog"`. Style it with `[open]`, `::backdrop`, `@starting-style` and `[data-ending-style]`.

dataAttributes.data-ending-style: Present while the alert dialog animates out. It stays open until the transitions and animations on it and its descendants finish.

AlertDialogTitle.description: A heading that names the alert dialog. The popup's `aria-labelledby` points at it.

AlertDialogDescription.description: A paragraph that describes the alert dialog. The popup's `aria-describedby` points at it.

AlertDialogClose.description: A button that closes the alert dialog, after running its own `onClick`. Use one for each answer.
